--로그체스 일정 범위 일정 범위 내에 있을 시 버프를 유지하는 옵션, 범위 탈출 시 즉시 해제
local local_class = newclass('RogueChessContinuousBuffArea')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.level = self.option.Level

	local buff_radius_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffRadiusBase')
	local buff_radius_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffRadiusAdd')
	self.buff_radius = buff_radius_base + buff_radius_adder * self.level

	self.buff_info_table = rogue_chess_util.parse_ability_buff_info(param)
	self.buffed_fo = {}

	self.activated = false
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.activated = true
	self.buffed_fo = {}
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.activated = false
	self:remove_buff_all()
end

function local_class:cast_buff()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.owner.Position, self.buff_radius)

	self:remove_buffs(fo_list)
	self:add_buffs(fo_list)

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:remove_buffs(fo_list)
	for i = #self.buffed_fo, 1, -1 do
		local removed = true
		for j = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.buffed_fo[i], fo_list[j]) then
				removed = false
				break
			end
		end

		if removed then
			for k = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
				print('RogueChessContinuousBuffArea - RemoveBuff: ' .. self.owner.Name
						.. ' to ' .. self.buffed_fo[i].Name
						.. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[k].name)
				buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.buffed_fo[i], self.buff_info_table[k].name)
			end

			table.remove(self.buffed_fo, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buff_all()
	for i = #self.buffed_fo, 1, -1 do
		for k = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
			print('RogueChessContinuousBuffArea - RemoveBuff: ' .. self.owner.Name
					.. ' to ' .. self.buffed_fo[i].Name
					.. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[k].name)
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.buffed_fo[i], self.buff_info_table[k].name)
		end

		table.remove(self.buffed_fo, i)
	end
end

function local_class:add_buffs(fo_list)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		local duplicated = false
		for j = 1, #self.buffed_fo do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.buffed_fo[j]) then
				duplicated = true
				break
			end
		end

		if not duplicated then
			if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsFriendlyTo(user_party.Leader.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) then
				for k = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
					print('RogueChessContinuousBuffArea - AddBuff: ' .. self.owner.Name
							.. ' to ' .. fo.Name
							.. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[k].name
							.. 'option_level:' .. self.level)
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
							fo, self.buff_info_table[k].name, self.level, false, false)
				end

				table.insert(self.buffed_fo, fo)
			end
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self:cast_buff()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

--로그체스 일정 범위 일정 시간 데미지 부여 옵션
local local_class = newclass('RogueChessDamageArea')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.level = self.option.Level

	local damage_time_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTimeBase')
	local damage_time_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTimeAdd')
	self.damage_time = damage_time_base + damage_time_adder * self.level

	local damage_radius_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageRadiusBase')
	local damage_radius_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageRadiusAdd')
	self.damage_radius = damage_radius_base + damage_radius_adder * self.level

	local damage_modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifierBase')
	local damage_modifier_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifierAdd')
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier_base + damage_modifier_adder * self.level

	self.area_fx_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AreaFx')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.area_fx_name)
	self.area_fx = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.activated = false
end

function local_class:apply_damage()
	self.area_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.area_fx_name):Instantiate(self.owner.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.owner.Transform)
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
			self.owner.Position, self.damage_radius
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			print('RogueChessDamageArea: ' .. self.owner.Name .. ' to ' .. target.Name .. ', dps modifier: ' .. character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) .. ', atk modifier: ' .. self.damage_modifier)

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.melee
			damage_info.source_type = damage_source_type.option
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.activated = true
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.activated = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed > self.damage_time then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:apply_damage()
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
end


return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

end

	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,

--로그체스 특정 시간동안 데미지 입지 않을 시 버프 부여
local local_class = newclass('RogueChessGatherEnergyOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.level = self.option.Level

	self.buff_info_table = rogue_chess_util.parse_ability_buff_info(param)

	local damage_boost_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageBoostBase')
	local damage_boost_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageBoostAdd')
	self.damage_boost = damage_boost_base + damage_boost_adder * self.level
	self.current_damage_boost = 0

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e) self:on_damage_event(e) end
	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	--해당 시간 동안 데미지 입지 않을 시 버프
	local buff_time_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffTimeBase')
	local buff_time_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffTimeAdd')
	self.buff_time = buff_time_base + buff_time_adder * self.level

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.activated = false
	self.buff_activated = false
end

function local_class:get_attack_modifier(_)
	return 1 + self.current_damage_boost
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.owner) then
		--print('RogueChess Energy Gathering - Time Reset' .. self.owner.Name)
		self.time_passed = 0
		if self.buff_activated then
			self:remove_buff()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_buff()
	self.buff_activated = true
	for i = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
		print('RogueChess Energy Gathering - Activate: ' .. self.owner.Name
				.. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[i].name
				.. 'option_level:' .. self.level)
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				self.owner, self.buff_info_table[i].name, self.level, false, false)
	end

	print('RogueChess Energy Gathering - Activate: ' .. self.owner.Name
			.. ' DamageBoost : ' .. self.damage_boost)
	self.current_damage_boost = self.damage_boost
end

function local_class:remove_buff()
	self.buff_activated = false
	for i = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
		print('RogueChess Energy Gathering - Deactivate: ' .. self.owner.Name .. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[i].name)
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info_table[i].name)
	end

	print('RogueChess Energy Gathering - Deactivate: ' .. self.owner.Name
			.. ' DamageBoost : ' .. 0)
	self.current_damage_boost = 0
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.activated = true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.activated = false
	if self.buff_activated then
		self:remove_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated or self.buff_activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed > self.buff_time then
		self:apply_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()

	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독 해지
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end


return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

--로그체스 일정 범위 일정 시간 힐 옵션, recovery 없을 시 버프 부여
local local_class = newclass('RogueChessHealBuffArea')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.level = self.option.Level

	self.buff_info_table = rogue_chess_util.parse_ability_buff_info(param)

	local heal_radius_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealRadiusBase')
	local heal_radius_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealRadiusAdd')
	self.heal_radius = heal_radius_base + heal_radius_adder * self.level

	local heal_time_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealTimeBase')
	local heal_time_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealTimeAdd')
	self.heal_time = heal_time_base + heal_time_adder * self.level

	local heal_multiplier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealMultiplierBase')
	local heal_multiplier_adder = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HealMultiplierAdd')
	self.heal_multiplier = heal_multiplier_base + heal_multiplier_adder * self.level

	self.area_fx_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'AreaFx')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.area_fx_name)
	self.area_fx = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.activated = false
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
	self.area_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.area_fx_name):Instantiate(self.owner.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.owner.Transform)
	print('RogueChessHealArea-Heal: ' .. self.owner.Name .. ' to ' .. target.Name .. ' amount : ' .. heal_amount)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(heal_amount)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:apply_buff(target)
	self.area_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.area_fx_name):Instantiate(self.owner.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.owner.Transform)
	for i = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
		print('RogueChessHealBuffArea - Buff: ' .. self.owner.Name
				.. ' to ' .. target.Name
				.. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[i].name
				.. 'option_level:' .. self.level)
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				target, self.buff_info_table[i].name, self.level, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_heal_or_buff()
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(
			self.owner.Position, self.heal_radius
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_friendly_target(self.owner, target) then
			local heal_stat = character_util.get_recovery(self.owner)

			if heal_stat == 0 then
				self:apply_buff(target)
			else
				local heal_amount = heal_stat * self.heal_multiplier
				self:apply_heal(target, heal_amount)
			end

		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.activated = true
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.activated = false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed > self.heal_time then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:apply_heal_or_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
end


return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.death_rattle_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'DeathRattleOptionId')

	self.level = self.option.Level
end

function local_class:apply_damage()

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.death
	damage_info.source_type = damage_source_type.option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = self.owner
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

	print('DeathRattleExpired - Kill: ' .. self.owner.Name)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

function local_class:start(info)
	for i = 0, self.owner.CharacterBehaviour.StageOptions.Count - 1 do
		local so = self.owner.CharacterBehaviour.StageOptions[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(so, CS.Oak.DeathRattleAppliedStageOption) and so.Option ~= nil and so.Option.Id == self.death_rattle_option_id then
			self.death_rattle_option = so
		end
	end

	self.death_rattle_option = nil
	self.activated = false
	--if self.activated and not self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
	--	self:apply_damage()
	--	self.activated = false
	--end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.death_rattle_option == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.activated and not self.death_rattle_option:IsActivated() and not self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		self:apply_damage()
	end

	if self.death_rattle_option ~= nil then
		self.activated = self.death_rattle_option:IsActivated()
	end

	return true

end

	end

			.. 'Modifier : ' .. self.modifier
			.. ', SuperSkillModifier : ' .. self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.SuperSkillDamageMultiplier
			.. ', target: ' .. target.Name)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = damage_attribute_type.projectile
	damage_info.source_type = damage_source_type.option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner

	damage_info.modifier = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.SuperSkillDamageMultiplier * self.modifier

		self:apply_damage(self:search_target())
	end

function local_class:search_target()
	local current_battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(self.owner)
	local ret = nil

	if current_battle ~= nil then
		local enemies = current_battle.Enemies
		for i = 0, enemies.Count -1 do
			local target_character = enemies[i].Character
			if stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(target_character) then
				if ret == nil

						or character_util.get_max_hp(target_character) == character_util.get_max_hp(ret)
							and character_util.get_hp(target_character) > character_util.get_hp(ret) then

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option

	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c

	self.level = self.option.Level

	self.coop_class = {
		['Melee'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Melee,
		['Projectile'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile,
		['Tanker'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Tanker,
		['Supporter'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Supporter
	}
	self.target_class = self.coop_class[cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'TargetClass')]
	local min_count_base = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MinCountBase')
	local min_count_add = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MinCountAdd')
	self.min_count = min_count_base + min_count_add * self.level
	self.current_count = 0

	self.on_battle_enter_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_enter_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	self.on_battle_leave_event_func = function(e) self:on_battle_leave_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), self.on_battle_leave_event_func)

	self.buff_info_table = rogue_chess_util.parse_ability_buff_info(param)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.activated = false
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	if e.Battle:IsInBattle(self.owner) then
		self.activated = true

		self:refresh_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject == self.owner then
		self:remove_buff()
		self.activated = false
	elseif self.activated then
		self:refresh_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_buff()
	local prev_count = self.current_count
	self.current_count = 0

	if battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner) == nil then
		return
	end

	local targets = battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner):GetFriendlyTargets(self.owner)
	if targets == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
		if targets[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour  ~= nil and targets[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass == self.target_class then
			self.current_count = self.current_count + 1
		end
	end

	targets:Dispose()

	if prev_count == self.current_count then
		return
	end

	if self.current_count >= self.min_count then
		self:apply_buff()
	elseif self.buff_applied then
		self:remove_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:apply_buff()
	self.buff_applied = true
	for i = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
		print('RogueChessSwarmBuff - Add: ' .. self.owner.Name .. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[i].name .. ', level: ' .. self.level * self.current_count .. ', current_count : ' .. self.current_count)
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				self.owner, self.buff_info_table[i].name, self.level * self.current_count, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buff()
	self.buff_applied = false
	for i = 1, #self.buff_info_table do
		print('RogueChessSwarmBuff - Remove: ' .. self.owner.Name .. ' ' .. self.buff_info_table[i].name .. ', current_count : ' .. self.current_count)
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info_table[i].name)
	end
end

end

end

end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), self.on_battle_enter_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), self.on_battle_leave_event_func)
end

local local_class = newclass('Rudolph2SpecialOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot

	--- 자신에게 적용할 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
	--- 아군에게 적용할 버프 정보
	self.ally_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'AllyBuff')

	--- 적용할 재사용 대기 시간 (옵션 기본 쿨타임)
	self.cool_time = battle_constants.option_default_cool_time
	--- 남은 재사용 대기 시간
	self.remain_cool_time = 0

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e) self:on_damage_event(e)  end

	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--- 데미지 이벤트 구독 해지
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	--- 오너 할당 해제
	self.owner = nil
	--- 옵션 할당 해제
	self.option = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 로드 체크할 것이 없음
	return true
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 남은 쿨타임이 있으면 생략
	if self.remain_cool_time > 0 then return false end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info
	--- 데미지 이벤트의 공격자
	local sender = damage_info.sender
	--- 데미지 정보 오너 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, sender) then return false end

	--- 데미지 타겟
	local target = damage_info.target
	--- 데미지 정보 타겟 체크
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target) then return false end

	--- 추가 효과 데미지 여부 체크
	local check_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
	--- 데미지 타입 체크
	if damage_info.type & check_damage_type == check_damage_type then return false end

	--- 캐릭터인 경우에만 발동 (기믹 등을 무시)
	if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(target, typeof(CS.Oak.ICharacter)) then return false end

	--- 재사용 대기 시간 적용
	self.remain_cool_time = self.cool_time

	--- 아군에게 버프 적용
	self:apply_ally_buff()

	return false
end

function local_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 버프 적용
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)

	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 자신을 제외
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, self.owner) then break end

		--- 사망 여부 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.ally_buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.ally_buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)
		end

	until true end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 남은 재사용 대기 시간이 있는 경우
	if self.remain_cool_time > 0 then
		--- 남은 재사용 대기 시간 갱신
		self.remain_cool_time = self.remain_cool_time - dt
	end
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.damage, self.on_damage_event_func)
	--- 데미지 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	--- 캐릭터 부쉬 진입 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterBushStateEvent), self.on_character_bush_event_func)
	--- 캐릭터 부쉬 진입 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_character_bush_event_func = nil

end

function local_class:deactivate()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	--- bomb 이펙트가 있다면 갱신 필요
	if self.fx_bomb then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.current_attach_target) then
			--- 폭탄 위치 갱신
			effect_util.update_object(self.fx_bomb, character_util.get_position(self.current_attach_target))

		else
			--- 폭탄 클리어
			self:clear_bomb()
		end
	end

	--- 이 밑은 usable 하지 않으면 의미가 없다.
	if not battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 내부 쿨타임 갱신
	if self.current_cool_time >= 0 then
		self.current_cool_time = self.current_cool_time - dt
	end

	--- 만료시간 갱신
	if self.current_expire_time >= 0 then
		self.current_expire_time = self.current_expire_time - dt
	end

	--- 만료되었으면 폭탄을 만료시킨다.
	if self.current_expire_time <= 0 and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.current_attach_target) then

		local info = option_trigger_util.create()
		--- 옵션 id
		info.option_id = self.option_id
		--- 부여자
		info.owner = self.owner
		--- 특능 발생한 타겟
		info.target = self.current_attach_target
		--- 싱크타입
		info.integer = self.sync_type.explosion
		--- 옵션 트리거 커맨드 배포
		command_util.publish_option_trigger(info)

		--- 폭탄 클리어
		self:clear_bomb()

	end
end

--- handle events
function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.damage) then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info

	--- 패시브 대미지면 무시
	if damage_info.type & damage_attribute_type.passive == damage_attribute_type.passive then
		return
	end

	--- 내가 공격자 라면 대상에게 폭발물을 붙여야 한다.
	local sender = damage_info.sender
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, sender) then
		self:on_attack_target(damage_info)
		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_character_bush_event(e)
	--- 현재 부착된 대상이 없으면
	if not self.current_attach_target then
		return
	end

	--- 부착된 대상이 아니면
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.TargetCharacter, self.current_attach_target) then
		return
	end

	--- usable 하지 않으면 의미가 없다.
	if not battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- fx 달고있는 녀석이 부쉬에서 나오면
	if self.fx_bomb and e.BushState ~= CS.Oak.BushCharacterState.Hide then
		local current_time = self.bomb_expire_time - self.current_expire_time

		--- 우선 setactive 해서 custom animator 를 깨움
		self.fx_bomb.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		--- custom animator 들 세팅
		for idx = 0, self.bomb_animators.Length - 1 do
			self.bomb_animators[idx]:SetProgress(current_time)
		end

		--- particle 들 세팅
		for idx = 0, self.bomb_particles.Length - 1 do
			self.bomb_particles[idx]:Simulate(current_time)
			self.bomb_particles[idx]:Play()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_attack_target(damage_info)
	--- 내부 쿨타임 체크
	if self.current_cool_time > 0 then
		return
	end

	--- 대상이 공격가능한지 체크
	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, damage_info.target) then
		return
	end

	--- 옵션 트리거 정보 생성
	local info = option_trigger_util.create()
	--- 옵션 id
	info.option_id = self.option_id
	--- 부여자
	info.owner = self.owner
	--- 특능 발생한 타겟
	info.target = damage_info.target
	--- 싱크타입
	info.integer = self.sync_type.attach
	--- 옵션 트리거 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_option_trigger(info)

	--- 쿨타임 갱신
	self.current_cool_time = self.cool_time
	self.current_expire_time = self.bomb_expire_time
end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 싱크타입 추출
	local sync_type = info.integer

	if sync_type == self.sync_type.attach then
		self:sync_attach(info)

	elseif sync_type == self.sync_type.explosion then
		--- 폭발함, 폭발 데미지
		battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'explosion', info.target, bounds_util.get_center(info.target))

		--- sfx 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)

		--- 대상 체력비율 기준으로 다른 데미지 계수
		if character_util.get_hp_ratio(info.target) <= self.hp_ratio then
			self:apply_damage(info.target, self.low_atk_modifier)
		else
			self:apply_damage(info.target, self.atk_modifier)
		end

		--- 폭탄 클리어 해줌
		self:clear_bomb()
	end
end

--- 특능 폭탄 부착 시 싱크
function local_class:sync_attach(info)

	local target = info.target

	--- 대상이 공격가능한지 체크
	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
		return
	end

	--- 부착된 대상이 없으면 이펙트를 생성해준다.
	if not self.current_attach_target then
		--- 폭탄 이펙트 생성
		self.fx_bomb = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'bomb', target, character_util.get_position(target))

		--- 부쉬 이벤트에 따라 조절해줘야 할 컴포넌트들 미리 캐싱
		self.bomb_animators = self.fx_bomb.transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
		self.bomb_particles = self.fx_bomb.transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))

		--- sfx 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end

	--- 현재 부착중인 대상 갱신
	self.current_attach_target = target
end

--- 특능 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 처리
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 옵션 강제종료시 대응
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:clear_bomb()
end

--- 부착중인 폭탄을 청소해주는 부분
function local_class:clear_bomb()

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_bomb then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_bomb)
		self.fx_bomb = nil
	end

	--- 부착 대상 초기화
	self.current_attach_target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('SlimeMilimCwpOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot
	--- 옵션의 레벨
	local level = option.Level

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_buff_add_event(e)
	end
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	end
	--- 액션 캔슬 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_battle_action_cancelled_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_battle_action_cancelled_event(e)
	end

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent), self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	--- 액션 캔슬 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(
		typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent), self.on_battle_action_cancelled_event_func
	)

	--- 무기 기술 사용시 적용할 버프
	self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param, 'CwpBuff')
	--- 피해량 감소 비율
	self.reduction_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReductionModifier')

	--- 체력 n 이상 피해 증가 트리거
	self.hp_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HpRatio')
	--- 데미지 증가율 (1 포함)
	self.boosted_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier') + 1

	---- 무기 기술
	self.cwp_action = nil
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent), self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	--- 액션 캔슬 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent), self.on_battle_action_cancelled_event_func)

	--- 오너 할당 해제
	self.owner = nil
	--- 옵션 할당 해제
	self.option = nil
end

function local_class:deactivate()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

--- handle events

function local_class:on_event(e)
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerEvent) then
		return false
	end

	--- 전투가 존재할때
	if battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.owner) == nil then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거된 액션
	local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.owner, e.BattleActionName)
	--- 액션 타입
	local action_type = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionType(action)

	--- 무기 기술인 경우
	if action_type == CS.Oak.BattleActionType.Super then
		--- 무기 기술 캐싱
		self.cwp_action = action

		--- 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)
	end

	return false
end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:start(info)
end

function local_class:get_defence_modifier(_)
	--- 전투 중인 경우
	if battle_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then
		--- 버프가 유효한 경우
		if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info.name) then
			--- 실제로 액션도 액티브 상태인지 체크
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.cwp_action) then
				--- 받는 피해량 감소 적용
				return 1 - self.reduction_modifier

				--- 액션이 비활성화되었다면 강제 제거 (fallback)
			else
				--- 버프 제거
				buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info.name, self.slot)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 받은 피해량 기본 적용
	return 1
end

--- damage boost
function local_class:get_attack_modifier(target)
	if target == nil then return 1 end

	if character_util.get_hp_ratio(target) > self.hp_ratio then
		return self.boosted_modifier
	else
		return 1
	end
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff

	--- 버프 이름 체크
	if buff.BuffSpec.Name ~= self.cwp_buff_info.name then
		return false
	end

	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Sender) then
		return false
	end

	--- 생성된 버프 이펙트가 없는 경우
	if self.buff_fx == nil then
		--- 버프 이펙트 생성
		--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
		self.buff_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
			self, 'buff', self.owner,
			character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- 버프 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'buff')
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	--- 만료된 대상
	local expired_target = e.Target

	--- 만료된 대상 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, expired_target) then
		return false
	end

	--- 캐릭터에게 버프가 여전히 잔존하는지 체크
	if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info.name) then
		return false
	end

	--- 버프 이펙트 해지
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.buff_fx)
	--- 버프 이펙트 할당 해제
	self.buff_fx = nil

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_action_cancelled_event(e)
	--- 액션 비교
	if self.cwp_action and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BattleAction, self.cwp_action) then
		--- 버프 제거
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info.name, self.slot)
	end

	return false
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

	self.on_battle_enter_event_func = nil
	self.on_battle_leave_event_func = nil

--- update frame

--- handle events

end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:start(info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	--- 옵션 레퍼런스가 dispose에서 날아간 상태라면 이벤트를 처리하지 않도록 방어조치
	if not self.option then return end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.owner) then return end

	if not battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then return end

	--- 치명타 저항 버프 적용
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.crit_res_buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	--- 옵션 레퍼런스가 dispose에서 날아간 상태라면 이벤트를 처리하지 않도록 방어조치
	if not self.option then return end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.owner) then return end

	if battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then return end

	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.crit_res_buff_info.name, self.slot)

--- 전용 무기 옵션
--- 스나이퍼 헤카테 (sniper) 무기 옵션
local local_class = newclass('SniperCwpOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot

	--- parsing each info
	_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_option_param(self.owner, param)

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- attack modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackModifier')
	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 정보
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function local_class:apply_option(param)
	local special_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'SpecialOptionId')
	local activate_option, _ = battle_util.parse_option_data(special_option_id, self.owner)

	--- 특수 능력이 발동 중이 아니라면 생략함
	if not activate_option then return end

	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	self.activate_special_option = true

	--- 발동에 필요한 피격되지 않은 시간
	self.require_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RequireTime')
	--- 마지막으로 맞은지 경과한 시간
	self.time_passed = 0

	--- 버프 정보
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)
	--- 사용할 버프 정보의 파라미터
	local buff_param = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.buff_info.name).Data
	--- 버프 아이디
	self.buff_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(buff_param, 'Id')

	--- 버프 활성화 여부
	self.buff_active_flag = false
	--- 버프 이펙트 프리셋
	self.buff_fx = nil

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_add_event(e) end
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_expired_event(e) end

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
	if self.activate_special_option then
		--- 버프 해제
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info.name, self.slot)

		--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독 해제
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
		--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독 해제
		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)

		--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해지
		self.on_buff_add_event_func = nil
		--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해지
		self.on_buff_expired_event_func = nil
	end

	--- 옵션 정보를 담고 있는 테이블 비워줌
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

	--- 오너 할당 해제
	self.owner = nil
	--- 옵션 할당 해제
	self.option = nil
	--- 판정 계산기 할당 해제
	self.calculator = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 체크
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 특수 능력이 발동 중이 아니면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.activate_special_option then return end

	--- 시간 갱신
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--- 버프가 걸려있고, 요구 시간 미만인 경우
	if self.buff_active_flag and self.time_passed < self.require_time then
		--- 버프 해제
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info.name, self.slot)
		--- 버프 플래그 갱신
		self.buff_active_flag = false

	--- 버프가 걸려있지 않고 요구 시간을 충족한 경우
	elseif not self.buff_active_flag and self.time_passed >= self.require_time then
		--- 버프 부여
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)
		--- 버프 플래그 갱신
		self.buff_active_flag = true
	end
end

--- handle events
function local_class:on_event(e)
	--- 특수 능력이 발동 중이 아니면 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.activate_special_option then return false end

	--- 이벤트 타입 체크
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.damage) then return false end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info
	--- 데미지 타겟
	local target = damage_info.target
	--- 데미지 정보 타겟 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target) then return false end

	--- 타이머 초기화
	self.time_passed = 0

	return false
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff

	--- 버프 이름 체크
	if buff.BuffSpec.Id ~= self.buff_id then return end
	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Sender) then return end
	--- 버프를 받은 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Target) then return end
	--- [세계탐험] 이펙트를 생성할 수 없는 상황이라면 생략함
	if self.ignore_fx then return end
	--- 이펙트가 이미 있다면 생략함
	if self.buff_fx then return end

	--- 버프 부착
	self.buff_fx = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
		self,
		'buff',
		self.owner,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 부쉬에 들어가있는 상황이면 부쉬쪽에서 제어해줄 것이라 생략함
	if not bush_util.is_hide(self.owner) then
		--- 이펙트의 액티브 상태를 덮어씌움
		effect_util.change_active_self(self.buff_fx, spine_util.get_spine_container_active(self.owner))
	end

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'buff')
	end
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	--- 만료된 대상 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.Target) then return false end

	--- 버프 만료 여부
	local is_expired = false

	--- 해지된 버프 체크
	for _, expired_id in pairs(e.BuffIds) do
		if expired_id == self.buff_id then
			is_expired = true
			break
		end
	end

	--- 만료 목록에 없거나 아직 버프가 있다면 생략
	if not is_expired or character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_id) then
		return
	end

	--- 이펙트를 해제한 상태라면 생략함
	if not self.buff_fx then return end

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.buff_fx)
	self.buff_fx = nil
end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 위치
	local target_pos = info.targetPosition

	--- 폭발 연출
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', target_pos)
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

	--- 판정 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
	--- 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 판정 처리
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 피격된 대상이 없다면 생략한다.
	if #fo_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 부여
	local modifier = character_util.get_atk_2_dps(self.owner) * self.atk_modifier
	for _, t in pairs(fo_list) do
		self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
	damage_info.source_type = damage_source_type.cwp_option
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

--- 특수 능력 옵션
--- 영혼술사 도화 (soulpower_girl) 특수 능력
local local_class = newclass('SunyeoSpecialOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot
	--- 옵션의 레벨
	local level = option.Level

	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(param)

	self.owner_elemental_type = character_util.get_elemental_type(self.owner)
	self.buff_targets = {}

	--- ref - BuffOption, 메인 스토리에서 파티원 추가 제거가 빈번
	self.on_party_member_add_event_func = function(e) self:on_party_member_add(e) end
	self.on_party_member_remove_event_func = function(e) self:on_party_member_remove(e) end

	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.party_member_added, self.on_party_member_add_event_func)
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.party_member_removed, self.on_party_member_remove_event_func)

	self.party = party_util.get_party_for(self.owner)

	--- 스테이지 내부 컨트롤이 이미 시작된 상태
	if stage.StageControlStarted then
		--- 버프 적용
		self:apply_buff()
	else
		--- 스테이지 컨트롤 시작 이벤트 처리 함수
		self.on_stage_control_start_event_func = function(e) self:on_stage_control_start(e) end
		--- 스테이지 컨트롤 시작 이벤트 구독
		message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.stage_control_start, self.on_stage_control_start_event_func)
	end
end

--- dispose option
function local_class:dispose()
	self.buff_targets = nil

	--- 스테이지 시작 이벤트 처리 함수가 있는 경우
	if self.on_stage_control_start_event_func then

		message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.stage_control_start, self.on_stage_control_start_event_func)
		--- 스테이지 컨트롤 시작 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
		self.on_stage_control_start_event_func = nil
	end

	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.party_member_added, self.on_party_member_add_event_func)
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.party_member_removed, self.on_party_member_remove_event_func)

	--- 오너 할당 해제
	self.owner = nil
	--- 옵션 할당 해제
	self.option = nil

end

function local_class:deactivate()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- update frame
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
end

--- handle events
function local_class:on_event(e)
end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:start(info)
end

--- option trigger start
function local_class:on_stage_control_start(e)
	self:apply_buff()

	return false
end
--- option trigger start
function local_class:on_party_member_add(e)
	if not stage.StageControlStarted then return false end

	--- 멤버가 추가된 파티가 내 파티인 경우
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Party, self.party) then
		--- 버프 적용
		self:apply_buff()

		--- 옵션의 오너가 파티에 추가된 경우
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Character, self.owner) then
		--- 파티 갱신
		self.party = e.Party
		--- 버프 적용
		self:apply_buff()
	end

	return false

end
--- option trigger start
function local_class:on_party_member_remove(e)
	--- 스테이지 내부 컨트롤이 시작된 상태가 아닌 경우
	if not stage.StageControlStarted then return false end

	--- 현재 파티에서 실제로 해당 영웅이 사라지지 않았다면 아무 조치 하지 않음
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Party, self.party) and self.party:Contains(e.Character) then return true end

	--- 오너가 제거됨
	if e.Character == self.owner then
		local characters = party_util.get_party_for(self.owner)

		if characters ~= nil then
			for idx = 0, characters.Count - 1 do
				repeat
					local target = characters[idx]
					--- 파티원이 본인인 경우
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.owner) then
						break
					end
					--- 버프가 적용되어 있지 않은 경우
					if not self.buff_targets[target] then
						break
					end

					self:remove_buff(target)
				until true
			end
		end

		--- 오너가 제거된 파티가 캐싱한 파티인 경우
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Party, self.party) then
			--- 파티 캐싱 할당 해제
			self.party = nil
		end

		--- 파티원이 제거됨
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Party, self.party) and self.buff_targets[e.Character] then
		--- 버프 제거
		self:remove_buff(e.Character)
	end

	return false
end

--- apply self buff on start
function local_class:apply_buff()
	--- 자신이 해시에 포함되어 있지 않다면 스테이지 멤버가 없음
	if not self.party then
		--- 자신이 버프 적용되지 않은 상황
		if not self.buff_targets[self.owner] then
			--- 개별 버프 적용
			self:apply_buff_target(self.owner)
		end
	elseif self.party ~= nil and self.party:Contains(self.owner) then
		for idx = 0, self.party.Count - 1 do repeat
			local target = self.party[idx]
			--- 버프가 이미 있다면 제외
			if self.buff_targets[target] then
				break
			end
			--- 오너의 속성과 다르다면 제외
			if character_util.get_elemental_type(target) ~= self.owner_elemental_type then
				break
			end

			--- 대상에게 공증 버프 부여
			self:apply_buff_target(target)
		until true end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_buff_target(target)
	--- 대상 버프 적용
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.buff_info, nil, nil, self.slot)

	--- 버프 적용 플래그 교체
	self.buff_targets[target] = true
end

function local_class:remove_buff(target)
	self.buff_targets[target] = nil
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, target, self.buff_info.name, self.slot)
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

--- 싱글레이드용 배틀존 전체에 넉백/버프/데미지 옵션
--- 옵션 보유자가 죽었어있어도 작동하도록 만든 옵션이다. 이부분 주의해야한다.
local local_class = newclass('SRRArtilleryFireOption')

local bomb_class = {
    parent = nil,
    owner = nil,

    range = nil,
    calculator = nil,
    damage_ratio = nil,
    elemetal_type = nil,

    start_pos = nil,
    target_pos = nil,
    fall_duration = nil,

    time_passed = nil,
    is_active = nil
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(parent, calculator, range, start_pos, target_pos)
    local obj = {}
    setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

    obj.parent = parent
    obj.owner = parent.owner

    obj.range = range
    battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, target_pos)
    range:Show(parent.fall_duration);
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(parent.owner, range))

    obj.calculator = calculator
    obj.damage_ratio = parent.damage_ratio
    obj.elemetal_type = parent.elemental_type

    obj.start_pos = start_pos
    obj.target_pos = target_pos
    obj.fall_duration = parent.fall_duration
    obj.position = start_pos

    obj.time_passed = 0
    obj.is_active = true

    local projectile = battle_util.instantiate_effect(parent, 'projectile', start_pos)

    obj.projectile = projectile

    return obj
end

function bomb_class:update_position(dt)
    if self.is_active == false then return false end

    self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

    if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
        self.projectile.transform.position = self.target_pos
        self:process_damage(self.target_pos)
        self:play_explosion_fx()
        self.range:Hide()
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.owner,self.range))
        self:dispose()
        return true
    end

    self.projectile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
            self.start_pos, self.target_pos,
            unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.time_passed / self.fall_duration, 2))
end

function bomb_class:play_explosion_fx()
    self.explosion = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.parent, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
    battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.parent, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
end

function bomb_class:process_damage(pos)
    local calculator = self.calculator
    area_collision_util.start(calculator)
    area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, pos)

    local targets = area_collision_util.update(calculator, 0)
    for _, target in pairs(targets) do
        if target ~= nil then
            local knockback_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - pos).normalized
            local damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

            local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
            damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
            damage_info.sender = self.owner
            damage_info.target = target
            damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
            damage_info.damage = damage

            if self.elemetal_type ~= nil then
                damage_info.convertAttackTo = self.elemetal_type
            end

            command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
        end
    end
    targets:Dispose()
    area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
end


function bomb_class:dispose()
    self.owner = nil
    self.time_passed = 0
    self.is_active = false
    self.range = nil
    self.calculator = nil

    if self.projectile ~= nil then
        self.projectile:Dispose()
    end
end

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
    --- 옵션
    self.option = option
    self.owner = c
    self.slot = slot

    self.level = self.option.Level

    --- parsing each info
    _, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_option_param(self.owner, param)

    self.state = {
        none = 0,
        init_delay = 1,
        prepare = 2,
        shoot = 3
    }
    self.current_state = self.state.none
    self.activated = false

    self.damage_ratio_base = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRatioBase', 0.05)
    self.damage_ratio_add = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRatioAdd', 0.025)
    self.damage_ratio = self.damage_ratio_base + self.damage_ratio_add * self.level
    self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ShootInterval', 0.2)

    self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
    self.barrage_num = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'ShootAtOnce', 4)
    self.start_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'StartDelay', 2)
    self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'FallDuration', 2)
    self.target_manual = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'TargetManual', true)
    self.explosion_sfx_handle_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionSfx', '02_explosion_01')
    self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius', 1)
    self.scatter = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'Scatter', 1.5)
    self.elemental_type = nil

    local elemental_type_string = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'Elemental')
    if elemental_type_string ~= nil and elemental_type_string ~='' then
        self.elemental_type = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.GetFromString(elemental_type_string)
    end

    self.fall_height = 20

    self.bombs = {}

    self.time_passed = 0
    self.shoot_count = 0
    self.theta = 0.0
    self.target_pos_cache = vector_util.zero

    message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
    message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

    self.light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(121, 43, 244, 76)
    self.dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 153)
    self.overlay_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 128)
    self.overlay_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 53, 0)
end

function local_class:start(info)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
    if self.current_state == next_state then return end

    if next_state == self.state.shoot then
        self.shoot_count = 0
        self.theta = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, math.pi - 2)

        local target = nil
        if self.target_manual == false and
                lua_helper.type_compare(self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.IBattleAIState)then

            target = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Target
        else
            target = user_party.Leader
        end
        self.target_pos_cache = target.Position
    end

    self.time_passed = 0
    self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:deactivate()
    self.activated = false
    self.shoot_count = 0
    self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
    return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
    self:update_bombs(dt)

    if self.activated == false then
        return
    end

    self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

    if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
        if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
            self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
        end
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
        if self.shoot_count < self.barrage_num then
            if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_count * self.shoot_interval then
                self:shoot()
            end
        else
            self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
        end
    elseif self.current_state == self.state.init_delay then
        if self.time_passed > self.start_delay then
           self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
        end
    else
    end
end

function local_class:update_bombs(dt)
    for index = #self.bombs, 1, -1 do
        if self.bombs[index]:update_position(dt) == true then
            table.remove(self.bombs, index)
        end
    end
end

function local_class:shoot()
    self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

    -- 처음에만 발사음 출력
    if self.shoot_count == 1 then
        battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'prepare')
    end

    local offset = vector_util.zero
    if self.shoot_count > 1 then
        local rot = 2 * math.pi / (self.barrage_num - 1)
        local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-rot, rot) * 0.3
        local value = self.theta + rand + rot * self.shoot_count
        offset = vector(math.cos(value), 0, math.sin(value) * self.scatter)
    end

    self:shoot_bomb(self.target_pos_cache + offset)
end

function local_class:shoot_bomb(target_pos)
    --투사체 공격 계산기 생성
    local collision_info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
    collision_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
    collision_info.DamageTerm = 1
    collision_info.Radius = self.explosion_radius
    collision_info.Duration = 1
    collision_info.Height = 1.5

    local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.owner, collision_info)

    local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
            target_pos,
            self.explosion_radius,
            self.light_color,
            self.dark_color,
            self.overlay_light_color,
            self.overlay_dark_color,
            CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

    attack_range:Hide()

    --발사음
    battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'shoot', target_pos)

    local start_pos = self.target_pos_cache + vector_util.up * self.fall_height
    local bomb = bomb_class:new(self, calculator, attack_range, start_pos, target_pos)

    table.insert(self.bombs, bomb)
end

--region event
function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
    self.activated = true
    self:change_state(self.state.init_delay)
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
    --- 타이머 알림은 두번온다. 타임아웃에 의한 만료일때만 중단시켜준다.
    if e.IsComplete == true then
        self:deactivate()
    end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
    local target = e.FieldObject

    if target == user_party.Leader then
        self:deactivate()
    end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
    self.activated = false
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
    battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
    if self.fx then
        effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
    end

    self.preset_info = nil
    self.sfx_info = nil

    self.owner = nil
    self.option = nil

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))

    self.light_color = nil
    self.dark_color = nil
    self.overlay_light_color = nil
    self.overlay_dark_color = nil

    self.state = nil
    self.explosion_sfx_handle_name =nil

    self.target_pos_cache = nil
end

return {
    create = function(option, c, slot, param)
        return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
    end,
}

--- 싱글레이드용 배틀존 전체에 넉백/버프/데미지 옵션
---옵션 보유자가 죽었어있어도 작동하도록 만든 옵션이다. 이부분 주의해야한다.
local local_class = newclass('SRRBattleZoneEffectOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	self.owner = c
	self.slot = slot

	self.level = self.option.Level
	-- 삭제
	if self.level == nil then
		self.level = self:check_option_level()
	end

	--- parsing each info
	_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_option_param(self.owner, param)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		wait = 2,
		active = 3
	}

	self.initial_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'InitialDelay', 2)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageModifier', 0)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce', 0)
	self.debuff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DebuffId', 0)
	self.interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Interval')
	self.follow_owner = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(param, 'FollowOwner')
	self.action_apply_delay = 0.25
	self.zone = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleZoneBounds(self.owner)

	self.activated = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.count = 0
    self.battle = nil

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

end

--- 스테이지 시작 시점부터 작동시켜준다.
function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	self.activated = true
	self.next_shoot_time = self.initial_delay

	return false
end

--- 타임 아웃인 경우 종료 처리 해준다
function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.IsComplete == true then
		self.activated = false
	end

	return false
end
--- 전투 종료 시점에 작동을 중단 시킨다.
function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	self.activated = false
end

--- 옵션의 레벨
--- HACK : 옵션 레벨이 없어서 억지로 긁어옴
function local_class:check_option_level()
	local res = -1
	if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
		for _, option in pairs(self.owner.CharacterInfo.CharacterOptions) do
			if self.option_id == option.Id then
				res = option.Level
				break
			end
		end
	elseif self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour then
		for _, option in pairs(self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.Options) do
			if self.option_id == option.Id then
				res = option.Level
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if res == -1 then
		for _, option in pairs(self.owner.EliteOptions) do
			if self.option_id == option.Id then
				res = option.Level
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return res == -1 and 0 or res
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.next_shoot_time then
		self:shoot()

	-- 시전자가 죽었어도 작동하도록 만들었다. 이부분 주의해야한다.
	elseif self.next_hit_time and self.time_passed >= self.next_hit_time then
		local targets = nil
		if (self.owner.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
			targets = user_party
		else
			targets = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)
		end

		if not targets or targets.Count == 0 then
			return
		end

		for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local fo = targets[i]
			if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == false then
				if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.owner.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) == true then
					local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

					if self.knockback_force > 0 then
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
					end

					if self.knockback_force > 0 or self.damage_modifier > 0 then
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.owner
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = dir
						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end

					if self.debuff_id > 0 then
						buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, self.slot, fo, self.debuff_id, self.level, true, false)
					end
					music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info['damage_hit'])
				end
			end
		end
		self.next_hit_time = nil
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	local key = 'action'
	if self.preset_info[key] then
		local pos = self.owner.Position + self.owner.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
		if self.follow_owner then
			pos = self.owner.Position + self.owner.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
		else
			pos = self.zone.Bounds.center
		end
		music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info['impact1'])
		music_player:PlaySfx(self.sfx_info['impact2'])

		if self.fx then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
		end
		self.fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, key, pos)
		self.fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(1.3, 1.3, 1.3)
	end

	self.next_hit_time = self.next_shoot_time + self.action_apply_delay
	self.count = self.count + 1
	self.next_shoot_time = self.count * self.interval + self.initial_delay
end

function local_class:dispose()
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.option = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	--message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))

	self.game_timer = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.slot = nil
	self.zone = nil
	self.battle = nil
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('SRRBerserkOption')

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		wait_active = 1,
		active = 2,
		max_stack = 3
	}

	--- 파라미터로부터 프리셋과 사운드 정보를 획득한다.
	_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_option_param(self.owner, param)

	--- 전투 시작 이후 최초 발동 딜레이
	self.delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActiveDelay')
	--- 기본 데미지 부스트
	self.base_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseModifier')
	--- 옵션 레벨당 부스트
	self.add_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AddModifier')
	--- 최초 딜레이 이후의 발동 반복 간격
	self.interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Interval')

	--- 최대 중첩 레벨
	self.max_internal_level = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxInternalLevel')
	--- 중첩시 증가 레벨
	self.add_level = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AddInternalLevel')
	--- 오라 기본 크기
	self.aura_scale = vector_util.one * CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'AuraMaxScale',1.5)

	--- 내부 계산에 사용될 광폭화 레벨. 데미지에 영향을 준다.
	self.internal_level = 0													-- 시간에 따른 레벨 중첩

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	--- 상대적 오프셋 값임으로 vector zero를 기본값으로 세팅한다.
	self.pos_offset = vector_util.zero
	self.rot_offset = vector_util.zero

	--- 전투 종료 이벤트 처리 함수
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	--- 보스마다 세부적인 연출용 데이터를 가져온다.
	self:load_fx_offset_data()

	--- 오너의 스파인 컨트롤러. 없으면 시작전부터 뭔가 이상한 상황.
	self.spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)
end

--- 보스별 세부적 연출 데이터를 읽어온다.
function local_class:load_fx_offset_data()
	local datas = require('Battle/Option/SRRBerserkOptionData.lua')

	local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(self.owner)
	if char_spec == nil then return end

	--- ID 혹은 이름으로 찾는다. 가능하면 이름으로 찾자. ID 재활용이 불가능하다.
	local character_id = char_spec.Id
	local char_name = char_spec.Name

	local offset_data = nil

	if datas[character_id] ~= nil then		--보스 id로 오프셋을 한번 찾아본다.
		offset_data = datas[character_id]
	else									--그래도 없다면 name_key를 포함하는 보스인지 두루뭉술하게 찾아본다. (보스마다 네이밍 규칙이 있으니..)
		for _, data in pairs(datas) do
			local start_idx, end_idx, _ = string.find(char_name, data.name_key)
			if start_idx ~= nil and start_idx > 0 then
				offset_data = data
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 오프셋 정보가 있다면 잇는것들은 세팅해준다.
	if offset_data ~= nil then
		--- 포지션
		if offset_data.pos_offset ~= nil then
			local offset = offset_data.pos_offset
			self.pos_offset = vector(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3])
		end

		--- 회전각, normalized 된 것으로 넘겨준다.
		if offset_data.rot_offset ~= nil then
			local offset = offset_data.rot_offset
			self.rot_offset = vector_util.normalized(vector(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3]))
		end

		--- 아우라 크기
		if offset_data.aura_scale ~= nil then
			self.aura_scale = vector_util.one * offset_data.aura_scale
		end

		---TODO, FIXME: battle_init쪽에  preset의 파싱과 생성을 분리한 것을 만들어서, 파싱 후 교체하도록 수정한다.
		--- 교체할 광폭화 시작 fx 이름
		if offset_data.replace_start_fx_name ~= nil then
			local new_start_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(offset_data.replace_start_fx_name)
			self.preset_info['impact'] = new_start_fx_pool
		end

		--- 교체할 광폭화 오라 fx 이름
		if offset_data.replace_aura_fx_name ~= nil then
			local new_aura_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(offset_data.replace_aura_fx_name)
			self.preset_info['aura'] = new_aura_fx_pool
		end

		self.bone_name = 'bone_eff'
		if offset_data.follower_bone_name ~= nil then
			self.bone_name = offset_data.follower_bone_name
		end
	end

	--아래 값 켜놔야 재도전 할 때 data 값을 다시 읽음. 안그럼 껐다 켜야함
	package.loaded['Battle/Option/SRRBerserkOptionData.lua'] = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.owner = nil
	self.slot = nil

	--- 전투 시작 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	--- 파싱한 데이터 해지
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
	--- 버프 이펙트 해지
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aura_fx)
	--- 버프 이펙트 할당 해제
	self.aura_fx = nil
	--- 버프 이펙트 해지
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.impact_fx)
	--- 버프 이펙트 할당 해제
	self.impact_fx = nil

	--- 프리셋 테이블 해제
	self.preset_info = nil
	--- 사운드 테이블 해제
	self.sfx_info = nil

	--- 오너 할당 해제
	self.owner = nil
	--- 옵션 할당 해제
	self.option = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.rot_offset = nil
	self.pos_offset = nil

	self.aura_follower = nil
	self.start_follower = nil
	self.spine_controller = nil

	self.bone_name = nil
end

function local_class:deactivate()

end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	--- 파괴된 개체가 광폭화 소지자가 아니라면 무시한다.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.FieldObject) == false then
		return false
	end

	--- 광폭화 소지자가 죽었다. 종료한다.
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 이펙트가 있다면 소거 처리
	if self.impact_fx ~= nil then
		self.impact_fx:Dispose()
		self.impact_fx = nil
	end

	if self.aura_fx ~= nil then
		self.aura_fx:Dispose()
		self.aura_fx = nil
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == nil or next_state == self.current_state then return end

	if next_state == self.state.wait_active then

	elseif next_state == self.state.active then
		--- 발동 타이밍에 레벨을 올려준다.
		self.internal_level = self.internal_level + self.add_level
		--- 연출 재생
		self:play_aura_fx()
		self:play_start_fx()
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:get_attack_modifier(_)
	--- 기본 부스트 + 중첩된 레벨X추가부스트를 반환한다.
	return self.base_modifier + self.add_modifier * self.internal_level
end

function local_class:on_stage_start(e)
	--- 초기 딜레이를 위해 활성 대기 상태로 변경
	self:change_state(self.state.wait_active)
	self.time_passed = 0
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--- 최초 발동 딜레이
	if self.current_state == self.state.wait_active then
		if self.time_passed > self.delay then
			--- 발동 딜레이 이후 활성화
			self:change_state(self.state.active)
			--- 지난 시간에서 delay만큼만 빼준다. 정확한 계산을 위해 0으로 초기화 X
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.delay
		end
	--- 완전 활성화 상태, 내부적으로 시간을 재면서 1씩 증가시킨다.
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.active then
		if self.time_passed > self.interval then
			--- 반복 주기가 되었다. 레벨 증가가 가능하다면
			if self.internal_level < self.max_internal_level then
				--- 레벨을 증가 시키고 이펙트 재생
				self.internal_level = self.internal_level + self.add_level
				self:play_aura_fx()
				self:play_start_fx()
			else
				--- 최대 레벨을 넘겼으니 더이상 폭발이펙트랑 레벨을 증가시키진 않는다.
				self:change_state(self.state.max_stack)
			end

			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.interval
		end
	end

	--- 추적중인 스켈레톤이 다른 방향의 것이라면 현재 방향걸로 갱신해준다. (그래야 오라가 현재 애니메이션의 방향을 정상 갱신된다._
	if self.aura_follower ~= nil and self.aura_follower.SkeletonRenderer ~= self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation then
		self.aura_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
	end
end

function local_class:play_aura_fx(target)
	--- 광폭화 지속 이펙트가 없는 경우
	if self.aura_fx ~= nil then
		return
	end

	--- 광폭화 지속 이펙트 생성.
	--- 이펙트는 광폭화 대상의 포지션만 추적한다.
	self.aura_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'aura',
			self.owner.Position + self.pos_offset,
			self.rot_offset,
			self.owner.Transform,
			parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	if self.aura_fx then
		--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트 (PooledUnityObject의 GetComponentInChildren는 캐싱)
		local bone_follower = self.aura_fx:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
		bone_follower.boneName = nil

		--- 회전각이 있다면 수정
		self.aura_fx.transform:Rotate(self.rot_offset)
		--- 광폭화 이펙트에 스케일 적용
		self.aura_fx.transform.localScale = self.aura_scale

		if self.bone_name ~= nil and self.bone_name ~= '' then
			local has_eff_bone = self.owner.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.Skeleton:FindBone(self.bone_name) ~= nil
			if self.owner.SpineController ~= nil and has_eff_bone then
				self.aura_follower = bone_follower

				--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트가 있는 경우
				if bone_follower then
					--- 본 팔로워가 따라갈 스켈레톤 설정
					bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
					--- 본팔로워의 본 설정
					bone_follower:SetBone(self.bone_name)
					--- 본 팔로워가 본의 로테이션을 따라가지 않도록 설정
					bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
					--- 본 팔로워가 본의 flip에 의해 scale이 반전되지 않도록 설정
					bone_follower.followSkeletonFlip = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'apply1')
end

--- 광폭화 적용시 팡 하고 터지는 이펙트 재생
function local_class:play_start_fx()
	--- 광폴화 시작 이펙트 생성
	self.impact_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'impact',
		self.owner.Position + self.pos_offset,
		self.rot_offset,
		self.owner.Transform,
		parent_follow_flag.position	--- 포지션만 추적하도록 설정
	)
	--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트 (PooledUnityObject의 GetComponentInChildren는 캐싱)
	local bone_follower = self.impact_fx:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.boneName = nil

	--- 광폴화 시작 이펙트가 생성되었을때
	if self.impact_fx then
		self.impact_fx.transform:Rotate(self.rot_offset)
		--- 광폭화 이펙트에 스케일 적용
		self.impact_fx.transform.localScale = self.aura_scale

		if self.bone_name ~= nil and self.bone_name ~= '' then
			local has_eff_bone = self.owner.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.Skeleton:FindBone(self.bone_name) ~= nil
			if has_eff_bone then
				self.start_follower = bone_follower

				--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트가 있는 경우
				if bone_follower then
					--- 본 팔로워가 따라갈 스켈레톤 설정
					bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
					--- 본팔로워의 본 설정
					bone_follower:SetBone(self.bone_name)
					--- 본 팔로워가 본의 로테이션을 따라가지 않도록 설정
					bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
					--- 본 팔로워가 본의 flip에 의해 scale이 반전되지 않도록 설정
					bone_follower.followSkeletonFlip = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'apply2')
end

return {
	create = function(option, c, slot, param)
		return local_class(option, c, slot, param)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('SRROnDamageCountBuffReverseOption')

--피격시 5..4..3..2..1 순으로 카운트. 피격카운트를 다 채우면 디버프가 걸리는 옵션
--일정 시간이 지나면 다시 카운트 회수 초기화

--- init stage option
function local_class:init(option, c, slot, param)
	--- 옵션
	self.option = option
	--- 옵션의 오너
	self.owner = c
	--- 옵션이 발동한 슬롯 정보
	self.slot = slot

	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		playing = 2,
		cleared = 3,
	}

	_, _, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_option_param(self.owner, param)

	self.max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'MaxCount', 1)        -- 내부 중첩 레벨

	self.buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'BuffId', 0)                -- 버프 ID
	self.is_for_party = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'IsForParty', false)        -- 모든 파티원에게 버프를 발라줄지 여부
	self.hold_if_buff_exist = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'HoldIfBuffExist', false)        -- 버프 유지 중 부여 여부

	self.buff_duration = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'BuffDuration', 10)

	self.current_count = self.max_count

	self.count_ui = nil
	self.prevent_buff = false

	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
	self.time_passed = 0

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	--소환수나 다른 개체들로 인해 한번씩 더 트리거 되는 현상 수정 (암흑 마법사 소환물로 OnBattleStart가 계속 트리거됨)
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUICharacterState')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 카운트 UI 초기화 후 off 상태
function local_class:on_stage_start(e)
	local offset = vector(0, self.owner.Bounds.size.y + 1, 0)
	local count_ui_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUICharacterState'):Instantiate(self.owner.Position + offset, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.owner .Transform)
	self.count_ui = count_ui_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUICharacterState))

	if self.count_ui == nil then
		return false
	end

	self.count_ui:Init(self.owner)
	self.count_ui:SetIcon('ic_rules_defence_debuff.png')
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	self.current_progress = self.progress.playing
	self:reset_count()
	self:update_count_ui()
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
	self.current_count = 0
	self:update_count_ui()
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 버프 유지중 부여 방지가 아니라면 그냥 부여해준다.
	if self.hold_if_buff_exist == true and self.prevent_buff == true then return end

	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.playing then return false	end
	-- 피격 이벤트 후처리
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then return false end

	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = e.Info
	--- 데미지 이벤트의 공격자
	local sender = damage_info.sender
	--- 자기가 공격자면 리턴 리턴
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, sender) == true then
		return false
	end

	--- 데미지 타겟
	local target = damage_info.target
	--- 피격 대상이 내가 아니면 리턴
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, target) == false then
		return false
	end

	self.current_count = self.current_count - 1

	--최대 피격 횟수 넘어가면 디버프 부여
	if (self.current_count <= 0) then

		self:apply_buff()
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'apply')

		self:play_fx(self.count_ui)
		self.time_passed = 0

		if self.hold_if_buff_exist == true then
			self.current_count = 0
			self.prevent_buff = true
		else
			self.current_count = self.max_count
		end
	end

	self:update_count_ui()

	return false
end


--region Buff
function local_class:apply_buff()
	if self.buff_id > 0 then
		if self.is_for_party == true then
			local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)
			if party == nil then
				buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, self.slot, self.owner, self.buff_id, 1, false, false)
				--self:play_fx(self.owner)
			else
				for i = 0, party.Count - 1 do
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, self.slot, party[i], self.buff_id, 1, false, false)
					--self:play_fx(party[i])
				end
			end
		else
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, self.slot, self.owner, self.buff_id, 1, false, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_fx(target)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'impact', target.transform.position, vector_util.zero, target.transform --spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
end

function local_class:remove_buff()
	if self.buff_id > 0 then
		if self.is_for_party == true then
			local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)
			if party == nil then
				if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_id) then
					buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.owner, self.buff_id)
				end
			else
				for i = 0, party.Count - 1 do
					if character_util.has_active_buff(party[i], self.buff_id) then
						buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, party[i], self.buff_id)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			if character_util.has_active_buff(self.owner, self.buff_id) then
				buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.owner, self.buff_id)
			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion



--업데이트 프레임
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.playing then return end

	if self.current_count > 0 then return end
	--카운트 다운이 0이여서 버프가 부여되었다면 10초를 센다.

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--시간이 만료되면 모든 버프를 날려준다.
	if self.time_passed >= self.buff_duration then
		self:remove_buff()        --버프를 날린다.
		self:reset_count()			--스택을 초기화한다. max카운트로
		self:update_count_ui()    --UI상태를 갱신한다.
	end

function local_class:reset_count()
	self.current_count = self.max_count
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'count_ready')
	self.prevent_buff = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_count_ui()

	self.count_ui.Count = self.current_count

	local danger_level = self.current_count / self.max_count
