	self.proj_routine = nil
	self.explosion_routine = nil
	self.explosion_sfx_holder = nil

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 프로젝타일 생성 & 업데이트
function local_class:create_proj(shoot_pos, shoot_dir, target, target_pos)

	--- 프로젝타일 생성
	self.proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', shoot_pos, shoot_dir)
	self.proj_trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', shoot_pos, shoot_dir)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	return function(dt)
		--- 프로젝타일이 움직이고, 위치에 도착하면 터진다.
		if not is_unity_null(self.proj) and not is_unity_null(self.proj_trail) then
			local proj_pos = self.proj.transform.position + shoot_dir * self.proj_speed * dt
			effect_util.update_object(self.proj, proj_pos, shoot_dir)
			effect_util.update_object(self.proj_trail, proj_pos, shoot_dir)

			--- 프로젝타일이 도착했는지 검사
			local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos) - vector_util.get_x0z(proj_pos))

			if magnitude <= self.proj_speed * dt then
				self.explosion_routine = self:create_explosion(target_pos, target, shoot_dir)

				--- 프로젝타일 제거
				self:remove_proj()
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일 제거
function local_class:remove_proj()
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj)
	self.proj = nil

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_trail)
	self.proj_trail = nil

	self.proj_routine = nil
end

--- 폭발 생성 & 업데이트
function local_class:create_explosion(explosion_pos, target, shoot_dir)
	local explosion_time_passed = 0
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', explosion_pos)
	self.explosion_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	local hit_targets = {}

	return function(dt)
		local explosion_old_time_passed = explosion_time_passed
		explosion_time_passed = explosion_time_passed + dt

		for index = 1, #self.hit_timings do
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(explosion_old_time_passed, explosion_time_passed,
				self.hit_timings[index]) then

				--- 데미지 판정 시작
				area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, explosion_pos)
				area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

				local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.18, 0.15)

				for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
					local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
						self.cs_action, self.total_dps_multiplier / #self.hit_timings)

					--- 마지막 공격이면서 처음 노린 타겟일 때만 ailment 강제 변환 및 버프 적용
					local is_last = index == #self.hit_timings and lua_helper.reference_equals(target, each_target)

					self:apply_damage(each_target, dps, is_last, explosion_pos)

					if hit_targets[each_target] == nil then
						hit_targets[each_target] = true

						local dir = vector_util.normalized(bounds_util.get_center(each_target) - explosion_pos)

						if vector_util.magnitude(dir) == 0 then
							dir = shoot_dir
						end

						--- 방향
						dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 60, 0) * dir

						battle_util.instantiate_effect(
							self, 'hit',
							bounds_util.get_center(each_target), dir, spine_util.get_spine_container(each_target)
						)
					end
				end

				ifo_list:Dispose()

				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
			end
		end

		--- 특정 타이밍에 사운드 페이드 아웃
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(explosion_old_time_passed, explosion_time_passed, 0.7) then
			sfx_util.fade_out(self.explosion_sfx_holder, 0.3)
			self.explosion_sfx_holder = nil
		end

		--- 마지막 히트 시간이 끝나면 루틴 종료
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(explosion_old_time_passed, explosion_time_passed,
			self.explosion_duration) then

			self:remove_explosion()
		end
	end
end

--- 폭발 제거
function local_class:remove_explosion()
	self.explosion_routine = nil
	self.explosion_sfx_holder = nil
end

function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 마지막 타에 강제로 ailment 채움 & 버프 적용
	if is_last then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	--- 보호막 시전 타이밍
	self.barrier_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'BarrierTiming')

	--- 생성된 날개 이펙트
	self.wing_fx = nil

	--- 연계기의 대상

	--- 연계기가 트리거 되었는가?
	self.trigger = false
end

end

function local_class:on_start(_)

	character_util.jump(self.owner, self.jump_height, self.jump_duration, self.aerial_duration, false)

	--- instantiate wing fx
	self.wing_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'wing', self.owner.Position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	self.trigger = true
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.barrier_timing) then

		local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)

		if party == nil then return end

		for _, member in pairs(party) do
			if character_util.is_dead(member) == false then
				local container = spine_util.get_spine_container(member)
				local pos = container.position + bounds_util.get_size(member).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up

				--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
				battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'barrier', member, pos, nil, container)

				--- 소환수 이펙트 적용
				local summonables = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)

				for index = 1, #summonables do
					local entity = summonables[index]

					container = spine_util.get_spine_container(entity)
					pos = container.position + bounds_util.get_size(entity).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up

					--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
					battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'barrier', entity, pos, nil, container)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 연계기가 실행되었을때만 해당 루틴을 탐
	if self.trigger == false then return end

	--- dispose wing fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.wing_fx)
	self.wing_fx = nil

	--- cancel jump
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

	self.target = nil

	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.preset_info)
	self.preset_info = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	end

	support_action_util.unset_darken(self, self.is_canceled and 0.15 or 0.3)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_field, true)
	self.fx_field = nil

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

		self.fx_field = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'field', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.8) then
		--- 부채로 내려치는 연출, 막타 폭발 타이밍 쯤에 딱 걸치도록
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_field, true)
		self.fx_field = nil

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		self.is_canceled = false

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.3)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.5)
	end

	--- 데미지 타이밍 체크
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 데미지 타이밍을 지나쳤는지 여부 검사
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			--- 각 판정별 데미지 계수 계산
			local scale = is_last_hit and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.total_dps_multiplier) * scale

			--- 피격 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)) do
				--- 피격 대상들을 대상 중심으로 끌어당긴다.
				local knock_back_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(target)))
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last_hit, knock_back_dir)
			end

			if is_last_hit then
				self:apply_ally_buff()
			else
			end
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)

		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 전투 중이 아니라면 적용하지 않는다.
	if not battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then return end
	--- 아군 목록
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)
	--- 아군이 없다면 생략함
	if #stage_members == 0 then return end

	--- 아군 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 힐이 적용 불가능한 경우 생략함
		if not battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, member, false) then break end

		--- 크리티컬 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.crit_buff_info)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do

			--- 크리티컬 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.crit_buff_info)
		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment, knockback_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 상태 이상 적용 + 연계기 대상에게만 적용
	if apply_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 연계기 스턴 있어야하나?

	if knockback_dir then
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = vector_util.normalized(knockback_dir)
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
		damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_scale
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'sfx_debuff_hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	--- 오너가 유효하지 않다면 생략한다.
	if not self.owner then
		return
	end

	--- 내가 리더가 아닌 아레나라면 플래그를 올리지 않는다.
	if self.is_arena and not party_util.is_party_leader(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 전투 진입한 것이 자기 자신이 아니라면 생략
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.FieldObject) then
		return
	end

	--- 전투 진입 시 플래그 올려줌
	self.is_in_battle = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	--- 오너가 유효하지 않다면
	if not self.owner then

	end

	--- 전투 이탈한 것이 자기 자신이 아니라면 생략
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, e.FieldObject) then
		return
	end

	--- 자신이 속한 전투가 하나라도 있다면 생략
	if battle_manager_util.is_in_battle(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 전투 이탈 시 플래그 내려주고, 관련 변수 초기화
	self.is_in_battle = false
end
return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.trigger_pos))
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'jump')

	--- owner fade
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.03)

	self.spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false

	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 원래 있던 위치로 복귀함
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)
	--- rotation 원복
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 낙하 하는 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.drop_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.drop_timing, 1)
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * progress * self.jump_height + vector_util.back * 0.5)
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.trigger_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
		--- 캐스팅 애니메이션
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'slash')
	end

	--- 낙하 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.drop_timing) then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.2)
	end

	--- 낙하 베기 fx
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.slash_fx) then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'slash', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
	end

	--- 낙하 하는 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed,  self.drop_timing, self.landing_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed - self.drop_timing, 0, 5, self.landing_timing - self.drop_timing - 0.1)

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.jump_height * math.max(0, 1 - progress))
	end

	--- 착지 충격파
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.stomp_fx) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.25)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'stomp', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'stomp')
	end

	--- 낙하로 인한 직격 피해
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		self:apply_damage(self.target, self.sub_scale, false)
	end

	--- 폭발로 인한 2차 범위 피해
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.sub_hit_timing) then
		--- 피격 판정 범위 대상위치로 이동
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

		--- 피격 대상 순회
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			--- 주 대상만 공격
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target)
			self:apply_damage(target, self.main_scale, apply_ailment)
		end

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 폭발 fx
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_fx) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.5)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

		character_util.jump(self.owner, self.back_jump_height, self.action_duration - self.explosion_fx, 0)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
	end

	--- 백 덤블링으로 돌아가기
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_fx, self.action_duration) then

		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		if (look_dir & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			local angle = 0
			--- ease graph 를 이용한 progress
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed - self.explosion_fx, 0, 1, self.action_duration - self.explosion_fx)
			--local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((time_passed - self.explosion_fx) / (self.explosion_fx + self.action_duration), 0, 1), 0, 1, 1)
			if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				angle = 360 * progress
			else
				angle = -360 * progress
			end

			spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(angle, 0)
		end
		---포물선 점프 착지도 그리기
		support_action_util.execute_move_between_time(self.owner, self.target_pos, self.trigger_pos, self.explosion_fx, self.action_duration, time_passed)
	end

end

--- 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, scale, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target

	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.total_dps_multiplier) * scale

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	local diff = self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	--- x 축 기준으로 대상과의 거리
	local dist_x = math.max(math.min(math.abs(diff.x), 5), 1.5)
	--- 처음 도달할 위치

	--- 이동할 거리
	local strike_dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(self.second_pos - self.dest_pos))
	--- 각도 보정률
	local angle_adjust = math.max(1 - math.min(strike_dist / 5, 1), 0)
	--- 최종적으로 기울일 z 각도
	local final_z_angle = -(20 + 20 * angle_adjust)
	--- 최종적으로 기울일 y 각도
	local final_y_angle = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector).eulerAngles.y
	--- 로테이션 계산
	self.shield_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, final_y_angle, final_z_angle)

	--- 시전 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'declare', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.play_voice_in_args(
		self.cs_action, 1, character_voice_type.skill_1, character_voice_type.skill_2, character_voice_type.special_1
	)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무기 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	--- 고정 방향 설정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 원래 있던 위치로 복귀함
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 스파인 오프셋 초기화
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	--- 점프 연출 캔슬
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- 방패 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shield_fx)
	self.shield_fx = nil
	--- 트레일 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
	self.trail_fx = nil

	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 점프 시점 출력
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_start_timing) then
		--- 방패 이펙트 오프셋
		local shield_offset = self.shield_rotation * vector_util.right * 0.5

		--- 방패 이펙트 출력
		self.shield_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'shield',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + shield_offset,
			self.shield_rotation,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 트레일 이펙트 출력
		self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner))
		--- 점프 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'jump', self.trigger_pos)
		--- 점프 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'jump', self.trigger_pos)
	end

	--- 내려 찍을 위치로 도약함
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_start_timing, self.jump_end_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.jump_end_timing, 1)
		--- 위치 이동
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.trigger_pos, self.second_pos, progress)
		--- 점프 연출
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(
			spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.jump_height * CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(progress, 0, 1, 1)
		)
	end

	--- 방패 반짝임
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.flash_timing) then
		--- flash 이펙트는 방패 오프셋보다 0.5 더 높게 생성한다.
		local base_offset = vector_util.right * 0.5 + vector_util.up * 0.5
		--- 회전 적용
		local shield_offset = self.shield_rotation * base_offset

		--- 방패 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'flash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + shield_offset,
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 카메라 쉐이킹
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.1)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.strike_start_timing, self.strike_end_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.strike_start_timing) / (self.strike_end_timing - self.strike_start_timing), 1)
		--- 위치 이동
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.second_pos, self.dest_pos, progress)
		--- 점프 연출
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.jump_height * math.max(1 - progress, 0))
	end

	--- 이펙트 존재 시 위치 갱신
	if self.trail_fx then
		--- 트레일 위치 갱신
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner))
	end

	--- 돌아오면서 낮은 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_start_timing) then
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.2, self.return_end_timing - self.return_start_timing)
	end

	--- 원래 위치로 복귀
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_start_timing, self.return_end_timing) then
		support_action_util.execute_move_between_time(self.owner, self.dest_pos, self.trigger_pos, self.return_start_timing, self.return_end_timing, time_passed)
	end

	--- 판정 처리
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 첫 판정 시점에만 이펙트가 발생함
		if idx == 1 then
			--- 방패 해제
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.shield_fx)
			self.shield_fx = nil
			--- 트레일 해제
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
			self.trail_fx = nil

			--- 폭발 이펙트 출력
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
			--- 폭발 사운드 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
			--- 카메라 쉐이킹
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.3)
		end

		--- 판정 처리
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		--- 판정된 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			return
		end

		--- 데미지 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipier[idx])

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, idx == self.max_hit)
		end

	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, max_hit, is_last_hit)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = max_hit

	--- 마지막 타격에 주 대상에만 부여
	if is_last_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
		--- 상태 이상 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 하프 뱀파이어 프리실라(half_vampire) 양손검 연계기
local local_class = newclass('HalfVampireSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 판정 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Length')
	--- 판정 폭
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width')
	--- 판정 크기
	self.size = vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, self.width)
	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info)

	self.speed = 20

	--- 뒷 방향 오프셋
	self.offset = -1.2

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- 대상
	self.target = nil
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = nil
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.target = nil

	--- 데이터 해지
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 대상 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- 대상 위치 캐싱
	self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))

	--- 발사 위치
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치까지 diff
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - center)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.target_dir)

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.target_dir)

	--- 블링크 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'blink', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 캐릭터 알파 조정
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.01)
	--- 캐릭터 점프 요청
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 1.5, 0.85, 0.85)

	--- 오너 스파인 컨트롤러
	local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)
	--- 그림자 알파 조정
	spine_controller:SetShadowAlpha(0)
	--- 포지션 스프링 요청
	spine_controller:DeviateLocal(self.offset * self.target_dir, 0.15, 0.55, 0.15)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	if not self.trigger then return end
	--- 애니메이션 해지
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 오너 스파인 컨트롤러
	local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)
	--- 포지션 스프링 취소
	spine_controller:CancelDeviateLocal()
	--- 그림자 알파 원복
	spine_controller:SetShadowAlpha(1)
	--- 그림자 위치 원복
	spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.03, 0)

	--- 점프 취소
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)
	--- 캐릭터 알파 원복
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.01)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 가장 높이 올라간 시점 (레이저 발사)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.15) then
		--- 오너의 위치
		local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		--- 오너 스파인 컨트롤러
		local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)

		--- 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')
		--- 캐릭터 알파 조정
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)

		--- 그림자 알파 조정
		spine_controller:SetShadowAlpha(1)

		--- 순간이동한 위치의 땅 포지션
		local blink_ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(owner_pos - 1.2 * self.target_dir)
		--- 원본 위치와의 diff
		local diff = blink_ground_pos - owner_pos
		--- 그림자 위치 조정
		spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = diff + vector(0, 0.03, 0)

		--- 블링크 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'blink', spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position + 0.375 * vector_util.up
		)

		--- 레이저 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'laser', owner_pos - self.target_dir, self.target_dir)

		--- 레이저 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'laser')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.6)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.target_dir)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 판정 시간
	if old_time_passed < 0.7 and 0.15 <= time_passed then
		local tp = time_passed - 0.15

		local current_length = math.min(self.speed * tp, self.length)
		local current_size = vector(current_length, self.size.y, self.width)

		self.info.Size = current_size

		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, 2)

		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	 --- 레이저 발사 마무리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.7) then
		 --- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		 area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 애니메이션 해지
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

		--- 캐릭터 알파 조정
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.01)
		 --- 그림자 알파 조정
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):SetShadowAlpha(0)

		--- 블링크 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'blink', spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position + 0.375 * vector_util.up
		)

		 --- 방향 고정 해제
		 battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 원래 위치로 되돌아옴
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.85) then
		--- 캐릭터 알파 조정
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.01)
		--- 오너 스파인 컨트롤러
		local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)
		--- 그림자 알파 조정
		spine_controller:SetShadowAlpha(1)
		--- 그림자 알파 원복
		spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.03, 0)

		--- 블링크 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'blink', spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position + 0.375 * vector_util.up
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.95) then
		--- 폭발 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.3)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, 2)

		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier, lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target))
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 마지막 타에 강제로 ailment 채움 & 버프 적용
	if is_last then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

		return
	end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 결계 타이밍을 위해서 별도로 시간 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.15) then
		--- 결계가 발동하는 순간의 카메라 쉐이킹
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.1)
	end

	--- 프레임 마다 모든 판정을 체크를 해준다
	--- 저프레임에서는 타이밍이 몰려서 올 수 있기 때문에, 다음 프레임에 건너뛰어진 피격판정도 몰아서 계산해줘야한다.
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 데미지 타이밍 계산
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			if is_first_hit then
				--- 오각형 결계 fx 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'field', self.target_pos)
				--- 결계 생성시 사운드 추가
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'field')
			end

			--- 막타 연출 (1.1초 막타에 발생)
			if is_last_hit then
				--- 홀로그램 폭발 fx 출력
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
				--- 홀로그램 폭발 sfx 출력
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosionadd')

				--- 막타 폭발의 카메라 쉐이킹 조금 강력하고 여운남게
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.4, 0.4)
			else
				--- 결계 다단히트에 의한 카메라 쉐이킹 드드드득하고 균등하게 들어가는 느낌
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, (self.hit_timing[idx + 1] - self.hit_timing[idx]) * 0.8)
			end

			--- 각 판정별 데미지 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipliers[idx])

			--- 생성 지점을 기준으로 연출
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 피격 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last_hit)
			end

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 사운드 뮤트
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 암흑마법사 베스(invader_knight) 연계기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)

	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitDpsMultipliers')

	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	self:apply_myth_option(params)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(params)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(params, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	self.activate_myth_option = true

	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'Radius')

	self.dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'HitDpsMultipliers')
end

function local_class:on_start(info)
	self.target = info.target

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target.Position)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- calc modifier
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.dps_multiplier[index]
			)

			--- start calculator
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

			for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) then
					local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
					damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
					damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
					damage_info.sender = self.owner
					damage_info.target = each_target
					damage_info.modifier = modifier
					damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

					-- 데드셀 콜라보 피격 사운드 처리
					if self.owner.Costume and self.owner.Costume.CostumeSpec.Id == 170028 then
						damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_simple('02_hit_deadcells_01')
					elseif self.activate_myth_option then
						damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_dark_01')
					end

					if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, each_target) and index == #self.hit_timing then
						damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
						damage_info.force_ailment = true
					end

					command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.target = nil
	self.calculator = nil

	self.hit_timing = nil
	self.dps_multiplier = nil

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	--- sub damage scale

	--- height
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 원형 판정
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 정보

		radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 충돌체

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 왼쪽 기둥
	self.left_pillar = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'LeftPillarTiming')
	--- 오른쪽 기둥

function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			if activate_option then
				self.summon_id = CS.Oak.SuperBaseActionExtensions.GetOverrideInt(self.owner, option_param, 'SummonableId', 0)

	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

--- 강제 캔슬이 될 경우
function local_class:on_force_cancel()
	--- 아레나인 상황에서, 강제 캔슬 되었을 경우에만 소환수를 다시 소환해준다.
	if self.summonable and self.is_arena then
		if not summonable_util.is_summoned(self.summonable) and self.last_summon_pos then
			summonable_util.summon(self.owner, self.summon_id, 1, { self.last_summon_pos })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 타샤 소환수 엔티티 캐싱
	self.summonable = summonable_util.get_summonables(self.owner)[1]
	--- 소환수 마지막 위치를 캐릭터 위치로 우선 초기화
	self.last_summon_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false

	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self)
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_summon_spine then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_summon_spine)
		self.fx_summon_spine = nil
	end

	if self.fx_pillar then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_pillar)
		self.fx_pillar = nil
	end
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 추적하는 시간 내에는 대상을 계속 추적한다.
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
		end
	end

	--- 사운드 출력 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- play cast2 sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast2')
	end

	--- 소환수 해제 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2) then
		--- 소환수가 소환되어 있으면 위치 캐싱해두고 언서먼
		if summonable_util.is_summoned(self.summonable) then
			self.last_summon_pos = character_util.get_position(self.summonable)
			summonable_util.unsummon(self.summonable)
		end

		--- trail effect 생성
		self.fx_trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	end

	--- 지면 투사체 대상 위치로 접근
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2, 0.4) then
		--- 현재 fx 위치
		local fx_pos = self.fx_trail.transform.position
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(fx_pos, self.target_pos, math.min(dt / (0.4 - time_passed), 1))

		--- 지면 투사체 업데이트
		if 0.01 < vector_util.distance(next_pos, fx_pos) then
			effect_util.update_object(self.fx_trail, next_pos, vector_util.normalized(next_pos - fx_pos))
		end
	end

	--- 지면 투사체 접근 완료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4) then
		--- 투사체 이펙트 해제
		if self.fx_trail then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_trail)
			self.fx_trail = nil
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.7) then
		--- 소환수 스파인 생성
		self.fx_summon_spine = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'summon_spine', self.target_pos + vector_util.up * 6)

		--- 소환수 스파인 애니메이션 재생
		spine_util.set_track_animation(
			self.fx_summon_spine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController)),
			spine_animation_track.base,
			'attack2',
			false
		)

		--- play drop sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'drop')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.7, 1) then
		--- 현재 fx 위치
		local fx_pos = self.fx_summon_spine.transform.position
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(fx_pos, self.target_pos, math.min(dt / (1 - time_passed), 1))

		--- 소환수 스파인 위치 조정
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_summon_spine, next_pos)
	end

	--- 돌 올라오는 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		self.fx_pillar = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'pillar', self.target_pos)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.17)
	end

	--- 소환수 재소환 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[3]) then

		--- 연출용 스파인 해제
		if self.fx_summon_spine then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_summon_spine)
			self.fx_summon_spine = nil
		end

		--- 기둥 이펙트 바로 제거
		if self.fx_pillar then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_pillar)
			self.fx_pillar = nil
		end

		--- 소환수가 없을 때만 소환해주자.
		if not summonable_util.is_summoned(self.summonable) then
			summonable_util.summon(self.owner, self.summon_id, 1, { self.last_summon_pos })
		end

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

		--- 암전 서서히 해제
		support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.3)
	end

	--- 3타 폭발 카메라 쉐이킹 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[3] + 0.07) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.35)
	end

	--- 조작 불가능 시간 이후 락 헤저
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.controlling_duration) then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 막타 여부
		local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, is_last_hit)
		end

	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m, is_last_hit)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m * (is_last_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale)

	--- 상태 이상 적용은 막타에만
	if is_last_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, t) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 풍작의 신 카마엘(Kamael) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('KamaelSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 반경
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = nil
	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = nil

	--- 생성된 정령 이펙트
	self.elemental_fx = nil
	--- 정령 스파인
	self.elemental_spine = nil
	--- 생성된 차지 이펙트
	self.charge_fx = nil

	self:apply_myth_option(params)
end

--- 승급 옵션 적용
function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 범위 확장
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'Radius')
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- target pos
	self.target_pos = info.target.Position
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	---- instantiate elemental character
	self.elemental_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'elemental', self.target_pos)
	self.elemental_spine = self.elemental_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	--- set alpha reset
	self.elemental_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
	--- set alpha fade
	self.elemental_spine:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.2)

	--- set direction
	self.elemental_spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	self.elemental_spine.SpineOffset = 3 * vector_util.up

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 스파인 체크 trigger만 되고 start가 안될 수 있음
	if self.elemental_spine then
	--- offset reset
		self.elemental_spine.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end

	--- dispose elemental character
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.charge_fx)
	--- dispose elemental character
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.elemental_fx)

	--- fx 비워줌
	self.elemental_spine = nil
	self.charge_fx = nil
	self.elemental_fx = nil

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	self.target_pos = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- charge timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.15) then
		--- instantiate charge effect
		self.charge_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'charge', self.target_pos + 3.6 * vector_util.up)

		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.2)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.35) then
		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.55) then
		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.2)
	end

	--- 폭발 사운드 미리 재생
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing - 0.1) then
		--- play explosion sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
	end

	--- 판정 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- remove animation
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

		--- dispose charge fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.charge_fx)
		self.charge_fx = nil

		--- instantiate explosion effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.375, 0.35)

		--- 높이
		local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

		--- 데미지 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
			self.target_pos + height * vector_util.up, self.radius, height
		)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
				break
			end

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- set alpha fade
		self.elemental_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.4)
	end

	if self.hit_timing + 0.1 < time_passed then
		self.elemental_spine.SpineOffset = (3 + (time_passed - self.hit_timing) / 0.3) * vector_util.up
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.level = level

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- 데미지가 들어가야 할 시간
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(params)
end

---- parsing option data
function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 승급 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 승급시에 변할 데미지 타입
		self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(option_param, 'BaseDamageType')

		--- 승급시 데미지 변경
		self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')

		--- 마지막 투사체 이펙트 각도를 캐싱할 변수
		self.last_proj_dir = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos)

	--- 암전 처리
	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 승급시 연출
	if self.activate_ascent_option then

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트
		self.fx_cast = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

		--- 투사체 이펙트 생성
		self.fx_proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

		--- 꼬리 이펙트
		self.fx_contrail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'contrail', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

		--- 마지막 투사체 이펙트 각도를 캐싱할 변수
		self.last_proj_dir = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self)

	self:dispose_fx()

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

end

function local_class:dispose_fx()

	--- 승급하였을 경우 해지해줄 것들
	if self.activate_ascent_option then

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트 해제
		if self.fx_cast then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_cast)
			self.fx_cast = nil
		end

		--- 투사체 이펙트 해제
		if self.fx_proj then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_proj)
			self.fx_proj = nil
		end

		--- 꼬리 이펙트 해제
		if self.fx_contrail then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_contrail)
			self.fx_contrail = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 승급 여부에 따라 다른 업데이트를 탄다.
	if self.activate_ascent_option then
		self:update_ascent(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	else
		self:update_normal(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function local_class:update_ascent(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 투사체 위치 갱신 필요
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.hit_timing) then
		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)

		--- 현재 fx 위치
		local fx_pos = self.fx_proj.transform.position

		--- 남은 시간 체크
		local remain_time = math.max(self.hit_timing - time_passed, 0)

		--- 다음 lerp 도달점
		local next_lerp = 0

		if remain_time <= 0 then
			next_lerp = 1
		else
			next_lerp = math.min(dt / remain_time, 1)
		end

		--- 대상과의 거리가 유효할때만 방향을 갱신해준다.
		if next_lerp < 1 then
			self.last_proj_dir = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - fx_pos)
		end

		--- 현재 위치
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(fx_pos, target_pos, next_lerp)

		--- 이펙트 포지션 업데이트
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_proj, next_pos, self.last_proj_dir)
		--- 트레일 포지션 업데이트
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_contrail, next_pos, self.last_proj_dir)
	end

	--- 히트 타이밍에 히트
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)

		--- 암전 해제
		support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)

		self:dispose_fx()

		local target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))

		--- 히트 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', target_pos, self.last_proj_dir)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'stomp', target_pos)
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'lightning', target_pos)

		--- 데미지 계산 처리
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier)
	end
end

function local_class:update_normal(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 데미지 부여
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.15)

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'sword', target_pos)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'sword', target_pos)

		--- 데미지 계산 처리
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	)

	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- 데미지가 들어가야 할 시간
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(params)
end

---- parsing option data
function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 승급 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 승급시의 데미지 계수
		self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos)

	--- 암전 처리
	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 데미지 부여
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)

		--- 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'sword', target_pos)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'sword', target_pos)

		--- 각성 별 다른 처리
		if self.activate_ascent_option then
			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.23, 0.25)

			--- 암전 서서히 해제
			support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)

			--- 각성시 추가 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'lightning', target_pos)

		else
			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.15)
		end

		--- 데미지 계산 처리
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.degree = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CloneDegree')
	---
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CloneLength')
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹 강도 (HitDpsMultipliers 잘못 들어가있던 것 케어...)
	self.shake_scale = { 0.2, 0.8 }

	--- 실제 액션 실행될 첫번째 위치
	self.first_pos = nil
	--- 액션 끝난 시점의 최종 위치

	--- 아카유키 이펙트
	self.akayuki_fx = nil
	--- 아카유키 스파인

	--- 아오유키 이펙트
	self.aoyuki_fx = nil
	--- 아오유키 스파인
	self.aoyuki_spine = nil

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = nil

function local_class:on_dispose()

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- target pos
	self.target_pos = info.target.Position

	--- 캐릭터 발동시 위치
	self.trigger_pos = self.owner.Position

	--- 대상과 오너 사이의 벡터 차이
	local diff = self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	--- 캐릭터 방향 좌우로 고정할 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or (diff.x < 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(diff)))
	--- 고정 방향을 백터로 변환
	self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)

	--- 대상 위치의 바닥 위치
	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
	--- 대상 위치에서 높이를 맞춘 위치
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	--- 충돌 체크를 위한 바운드 생성
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 0.1)
	local first_dist = 3

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, first_dist * -self.dir_vector, false, false
	)
	--- 가까운 대상이 존재할때
	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
				bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신
		first_dist = math.min(first_dist, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 실제 액션 시전할 목표 위치
	local dist_vector = first_dist * -self.dir_vector
	self.first_pos = self.target_pos + dist_vector

	--- 캐릭터 지나쳐서 멈출 거리
	local second_dist = 2
	--- 대상 지나쳐서 다음 위치로 가는 경우
	closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
			bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, first_dist * self.dir_vector, false, false
	)

	--- 벽 발견된 경우 벽까지의 거리를 체크
	if closest_object then
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
				bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), self.dir_vector
		)
		second_dist = math.min(second_dist, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 마지막 도달거리에서 캐릭터 바운드의 extents 값 만큼 빼줌 (벽에 안파뭍히도록)
	local bound_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner)
	second_dist = second_dist - bound_size.x * 0.5
	dist_vector = second_dist * self.dir_vector
	self.final_pos = self.target_pos + dist_vector

	--- 돌진시 존 이탈 방지
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	end
	--- 돌진시 뚫고 나갈 경우 위치를 보정해준다.
	if zone_bound then
		self.first_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.first_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)

		self.final_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.final_pos,
			-self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end


end

function local_class:on_start(_)

	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)
	--- 대상 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 캐스팅 애니 시작
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

--- 클론 생성
function local_class:init_clones()

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast1')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast2')

	-- 포지션 결정
	local pos_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.owner.Position - self.target_pos, 0)
	pos_dir = vector_util.normalized(pos_dir)

	local up_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.degree, unity_class.vector3.up) * pos_dir
	up_dir = up_dir * (self.length * 0.7)

	local down_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-self.degree, unity_class.vector3.up) * pos_dir
	down_dir = down_dir * (self.length * 0.7)

	if self.be_locked == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		self.akayuki_start_pos = self.target_pos + up_dir
		self.aoyuki_start_pos = self.target_pos + down_dir
		self.fx_x_scale = 1
	else
		self.akayuki_start_pos = self.target_pos + down_dir
		self.aoyuki_start_pos = self.target_pos + up_dir
		self.fx_x_scale = -1
	end


	---- instantiate character
	self.akayuki_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'aka', self.akayuki_start_pos)
	self.akayuki_spine = self.akayuki_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.aoyuki_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'ao', self.aoyuki_start_pos)
	self.aoyuki_spine = self.aoyuki_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	self.akayuki_spine:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'cwp_akayuki')

	--- set alpha reset
	self.akayuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
	self.aoyuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)

	--- set alpha fade
	self.akayuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.15)
	self.aoyuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.15)

	--- set direction
	self.akayuki_spine.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
	self.aoyuki_spine.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

	self.base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)

	self.akayuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)
	self.aoyuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)

	-- 등장 모션
	self.akayuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'idle', true)
	self.aoyuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'idle', true)

	local fx_aka_key = self.fx_x_scale == 1 and 'aka_slash' or 'aka_slash_flip'
	local fx_ao_key = self.fx_x_scale == 1 and 'ao_slash' or 'ao_slash_flip'

	local fx_offset = vector(0, 0.3, 0)

	--- 등장 이펙트부터 종료 이펙트까지 한큐에 동작하게 됨.
	local akayuki_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.akayuki_start_pos, 0)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, fx_aka_key, self.akayuki_start_pos + fx_offset, akayuki_dir)

	local aoyuki_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.aoyuki_start_pos, 0)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, fx_ao_key, self.aoyuki_start_pos + fx_offset, aoyuki_dir)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았으면 취소 없음.
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 시전한 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 0.1 초에 clone_init 되기 전에 취소 당한경우에는 스파인 정리하는 과정 없이 캔슬 되도록 한다.
	if self.akayuki_spine ~= nil then
		self.akayuki_spine:Rotate(0, 0)
		self.akayuki_spine:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	end

	if self.aoyuki_spine ~= nil then
		self.aoyuki_spine:Rotate(0, 0)
	end

	--- dispose akayuki character
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.akayuki_fx)
	--- dispose aoyuki character
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aoyuki_fx)

	--- fx 비워줌
	self.akayuki_spine = nil
	self.aoyuki_spine = nil
	self.akayuki_fx = nil
	self.aoyuki_fx = nil

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target_pos = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--region 아오, 아카 동작
	-- 0.1 초 지난 시점에 이펙트 생성
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- instantiate cast effect
		--- 클론 스파인 생성
		self:init_clones()
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.15) then
		--- 눈빛 번쩍 할때
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'eye')
	end

	-- 준비자세
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.25) then
		-- 준비모션
		self.akayuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)
		self.aoyuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)
		self.akayuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_batto', false)
		self.aoyuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_batto', false)
	end

	-- 아카, 아오유키 이동 시작 지점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.55) then
		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)
		self.fx_move_time_passed = 0

		self.akayuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)
		self.aoyuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)

		self.akayuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_attack3', false, 20)
		self.aoyuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_attack3', false, 20)
		self.length = 7

		if self.fx_x_scale == 1 then
			self.akayuki_spine:Rotate(-self.degree, 0)
			self.aoyuki_spine:Rotate(self.degree, 0)
		else
			self.akayuki_spine:Rotate(self.degree, 0)
			self.aoyuki_spine:Rotate(-self.degree, 0)
		end

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'clone_slash')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.55, 1.1) then
		self.fx_move_time_passed = self.fx_move_time_passed + dt
		-- 기간동안 인터폴레이트, 1.0 - 0.45 = 0.55
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.fx_move_time_passed, 0, 1, 0.55)
		progress = math.min(progress, 1)

		--- 아카유키 이동
		local akayuki_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.akayuki_start_pos, 0))
		self.akayuki_spine.Transform.position = self.akayuki_start_pos + akayuki_dir * (self.length * progress)

		--- 아오유키 이동
		local aoyuki_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.aoyuki_start_pos, 0))
		self.aoyuki_spine.Transform.position = self.aoyuki_start_pos + aoyuki_dir * (self.length * progress)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1.1) then
		self.akayuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)
		self.aoyuki_spine:ClearTrack(self.base_track)

		self.akayuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_batto_end', false, 3)
		self.aoyuki_spine:SetAnimation(self.base_track, 'katana_batto_end', false, 3)

	end

	--- 환영 사라지는 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1.3) then
		--- 사라지는 사운드
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'disappear')
		--- fade
		self.akayuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.2)
		self.aoyuki_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.2)
	end

	--endregion

	--region 스미레 동작
	-- 시전위치로 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, 0.1) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, 0.1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.first_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	-- 스미레 이동 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.65) then
		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.5, 0.2)
		local y_offset = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		y_offset.x = 0
		y_offset.z = 0
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'slash', self.target_pos + y_offset, self.dir_vector)
		--- 스미레 돌진 모션
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'charge')
		self.owner_move_time_passed = 0

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')
	end

	--- 스미레 이동중
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.65, 1.2) then
		self.owner_move_time_passed = self.owner_move_time_passed + dt
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.owner_move_time_passed, 0, 1, 0.55)
		progress = math.min(progress, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.first_pos, self.final_pos, progress)
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 돌아가기전 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1.4) then
		self.owner.SpineController:Jump(1, 0.1)
		--- 점프 사운드
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'jump')
	end

	-- 1.4 ~ 1.5 원래 위치로 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1.4, 1.5) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed - 1.4, 0, 1, 0.1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.final_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- remove animation
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end
	--endregion

	--region 데미지 판정
	--- 판정 시점
	for idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			--- 데미지 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipliers[idx])

			--- 카메라 연출
			local scale = self.shake_scale[idx]
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.375 * scale, 0.35 * scale)

			--- 단일 타겟
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) == false then
				return
			end

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier, idx == #self.hit_timing)
		end
	end
	--endregion
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier, last_hit)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 마지막 공격에서 상태이상 강제 하도록
	if last_hit then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
